values.task_boundary: Build and run the evidence gate only; report blockers without absorbing their fixes.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Canonical #310 and every declared canonical or legacy predecessor are observed from the correct repository and canonical typed authority; required terminal, review, merge, ancestry, cleanup, and migration identities are exact.

AC-2: Every indexed v0.92 feature and supporting critical path has exactly one matrix row with stable identity, owner, implementation paths, reviewed head, PR/merge, validation, negative, integration, platform, claim-boundary, and typed-terminal evidence.

AC-3: Planned, open, unknown, fixture-only, receipt-only, demo-only, synthetic, substituted-provider, stale-review, non-ancestral, malformed-cache, fabricated-check, or platform-unproven rows fail closed.
AC-4: Documentation/planning rows are source-grounded and executable; tooling/cleanup rows prove measured value and regression safety; runtime/provider/consumer rows prove production-path behavior.
AC-5: Matrix, gate record, validation receipt, and findings-first blocker report are schema-valid and reproducible; downstream remains blocked unless every required row is accepted.
AC-6: A fresh exact-head independent review validates the denominator, validator behavior, and all dispositions with no unresolved actionable finding.
dependencies: Canonical #310 terminal, reconciled, ancestral, and cleaned
Legacy WP-04 #5821, WP-05 #5822, WP-06 #5823, WP-07 #5824, and WP-13A #5831 typed/terminal evidence
Current v0.92 feature index and milestone proof documents
repo_inputs: GitHub issue #311 and archived legacy #5842 body
Canonical and legacy C-SDLC terminal caches plus live GitHub and Git evidence
non_goals: Repairing incomplete product or documentation work
Crediting synthetic, fixture, demo, receipt-only, or provider-substituted proof
Executing WP-23, WP-25, release approval, or milestone ceremony
Mutating #310, dependency worktrees, external repositories, or cloud resources
